note: The script asks for five graphics: the hook text, two top question texts, one name super and one kinetic quote, then NIWRC's end card. The key words on row 00:11–00:20 are a caption pill in the caption file, not a library graphic.

mg.title: Hook question
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, top third: Are you happy? Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Off at 00:03.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third. Same look as the Brandi, Christie and Cory AYH cuts.

mg.title: Question text

text.main: What is the source of your happiness?

mg.cue: Top text at 00:03, 1.5 s: What is the source of your happiness?
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 and hold 1.5 s, in the top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:05 for 2.5 s, lower left above the captions: Lucy Simpson / Chief Executive Officer, NIWRC
mg.use: Put it on at 00:05 for 2.5 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Chief Executive Officer, NIWRC under the name. Name and title only.

mg.title: Question text

text.main: One message to the entire world?

mg.cue: Top text at 00:20, 1.5 s: One message to the entire world?
mg.use: Put it on at 00:20 and hold 1.5 s, in the top band, before she starts “it would be”. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Look to each other

text.main: look to each other for our strength

mg.cue: Kinetic quote, top third, word by word as she says it: look to each other for our strength
mg.use: Start it on “look” (about 00:25.5) so the words land with her voice. Out at the end of the line. Top third, captions stay on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: NIWRC logo, white on NIWRC red #981C20. One line under it: NIWRC × Happy Productions. The logo is here only.
mg.src: NIWRC logo (white) from NIWRC's onboarding brand file, in the brand kit 10 Oct 2026 (endcards/index.json). Client rule: white logo on red.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it right after “to the world.” (about 00:40) and hold it to the end. Music fades out over 1 s.
